pages.text: I hold the eye in my hand, and it looks back at me. My hands do not shake anymore. They glow so brightly now that the darkness around me looks like daylight. The voice is very quiet. Almost happy. I keep thinking about the first page of this journal, about how I wanted to remember the way home. I cannot remember where home was. I cannot remember why I wanted to go there. It does not matter. One more step, and everything ends, and after that, everything will be free. That is what the voice says, and the voice has never lied to me. Has it?
